why.title: You hire the photographer. Not a gig worker.
why.lead: Most real estate photo companies are middlemen who outsource your listing to whoever's closest. I shoot every property myself. I was the photographer for the Zillow Offers program in Las Vegas and provided Matterport services for builders like Lennar Homes.

cards.title: The actual photographer
cards.body: One point of contact. One standard. I capture, edit and deliver every shoot myself, never a rotating cast of subcontractors.

cards.title: Real-estate native
cards.body: A licensed agent working in the industry since {business.realEstateSince}. I understand listings, MLS workflow and what actually makes a buyer click, because I've been on that side.

cards.title: Certified & trusted
cards.body: FAA Part 107 drone pilot and Google Trusted Photographer. The credentials to fly near Las Vegas airports and publish to Google Street View.

cards.title: Fast, predictable delivery
cards.body: MLS-ready photos, tour links and floor plans in your inbox within 24–48 hours. Rush next-morning delivery available when you need to go live.
